"Meet llama.cpp: run large language models on the computer you already have"

If you have ever wanted to run a chatbot, coding helper, or image-aware AI model on your own laptop, llama.cpp is one of the friendliest places to start. It is an open-source project written mainly in C and C++, which means it can run on lots of machines without needing a giant Python environment or a special AI supercomputer.

What makes llama.cpp appealing to hobbyists is flexibility. It can run on ordinary CPUs, Apple Macs, NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, Intel hardware, mobile devices, and even some special accelerators. You can choose the backend that fits your hardware. There are also many quantized model sizes, from tiny to large, so you can try a model on a modest machine or load a bigger one if your computer has more memory.
